patch.summary: Set or clear the default chat and embedding model. Only the slots named in the body change.

put.summary: Add a provider, or change the key and/or address of a configured one: the body's models are re-tested, the rest are kept.

post.summary: Models only: test and add them to an existing instance with its stored key. Credentials in the body: create that instance.
